note: A474 (2026-11-23, Codex's audit #6, on Lawrence's "fix"). The APPROVED model manifests for the remote leg and limbs served by the TETSU gateway. covenant_leg.approved() reads this at every consult; a pin in private/leg.json, private/limbs.json or the environment that is not listed here is refused before anything is sent. Public hashes only (the gateway's sha256 over weights, runner, flags, sampler and chat template); no address. Tracked, so a change shows in git and in the head commitment's tree. The hashes move whenever a runner's flags change on TETSU (the hub tells us first); changing them is a re-pin, done in this file AND the private file together.
